54880-letters-from-a-son-to-his-self-mad.title: Copyright, 1903
54880-letters-from-a-son-to-his-self-mad.creator: Henry G. Pagani.
54880-letters-from-a-son-to-his-self-mad.description: A book by Henry G. Pagani.. You will be glad to hear that I shook the room in College Hall that Ma picked out for me, and by extraordinary luck secured a small apartment of five rooms and bath in one of the big dormitories. The dingy hole in "College" was so horribly noisy that I found it impossible to do my best work.

arxiv-2110-06304.title: Generalized Time Domain Velocity Vector Thanks: Both authors have equally contributed to the submitted article.
arxiv-2110-06304.creator: Srđan Kitić, Jérôme Daniel
arxiv-2110-06304.description: Abstract We introduce and analyze Generalized Time Domain Velocity Vector (GTVV), an extension of the previously presented acoustic multipath footprint extracted from the Ambisonic recordings. GTVV is better adapted to adverse acoustic conditions, and enables efficient parameter estimation of multiple plane wave components in the recorded multichannel mixture.

arxiv-2112-12071.title: A ctivity-based and agent-based T ransport model o f M elbourne (AToM): an open multi-modal transport simulation model for Greater Melbourne
arxiv-2112-12071.creator: Afshin Jafari, Dhirendra Singh, Alan Both, Mahsa Abdollahyar, Lucy Gunn, Steve Pemberton, Billie Giles-Corti
arxiv-2112-12071.description: Abstract Agent-based and activity-based models for simulating transportation systems have attracted significant attention in recent years. Few studies, however, include a detailed representation of active modes of transportation—such as walking and cycling—at a city-wide level, where dominating motorised modes are often of primary concern.

arxiv-2203-01834.title: General properties of fidelity in non-Hermitian quantum systems with PT symmetry
arxiv-2203-01834.creator: Yi-Ting Tu, Iksu Jang, Po-Yao Chang, Yu-Chin Tzeng
arxiv-2203-01834.description: Abstract The fidelity susceptibility is a tool for studying quantum phase transitions in the Hermitian condensed matter systems. Recently, it has been generalized with the biorthogonal basis for the non-Hermitian quantum systems. From the general perturbation description with the constraint of parity-time (PT) symmetry, we show that the fidelity ℱ \mathcal{F} is always real for the PT-unbroken states.

arxiv-2311-11897.title: Diffusion with two resetting points
arxiv-2311-11897.creator: Pedro Julián-Salgado, Leonardo Dagdug, Denis Boyer
arxiv-2311-11897.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pedro Julián-Salgado, Leonardo Dagdug, Denis Boyer. We study the problem of a target search by a Brownian particle subject to stochastic resetting to a pair of sites. The mean search time is minimized by an optimal resetting rate which does not vary smoothly, in contrast with the well-known single site case, but exhibits a discontinuous transition as the position of one resetting site is varied while keeping the initial position of the particle fixed, or vice-versa.

arxiv-2312-08236.title: Anomalous Tensile Strain Induced Enhancement in the Lattice Thermal Transport of Monolayer ZnO: A First Principles Study
arxiv-2312-08236.creator: Saumen Chaudhuri, Amrita Bhattacharya, A. K. Das, G. P. Das, B. N. Dev
arxiv-2312-08236.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Saumen Chaudhuri, Amrita Bhattacharya, A. K. Das, G. P. Das, B. N. Dev. Density functional theory based calculations have been performed for solving the phonon Boltzmann transport equation to investigate the thermal transport properties of monolayer (ML) ZnO under in-plane isotropic biaxial tensile strain. The in-plane lattice thermal conductivity ( κ L \kappa_{\text{L}} ) of ML-ZnO increases dramatically in response to the biaxial tensile strain ranging from 0% to 10%, conflicting the general belief.

arxiv-2408-07680.title: A Spitting Image: Modular Superpixel Tokenization in Vision Transformers
arxiv-2408-07680.creator: Marius Aasan, Odd Kolbjørnsen, Anne Schistad Solberg, Adín Ramirez Rivera
arxiv-2408-07680.description: Abstract Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures traditionally employ a grid-based approach to tokenization independent of the semantic content of an image. We propose a modular superpixel tokenization strategy which decouples tokenization and feature extraction; a shift from contemporary approaches where these are treated as an undifferentiated whole.

arxiv-2503-04737.title: Carelessness Detection using Performance Factor Analysis: A New Operationalization with Unexpectedly Different Relationship to Learning
arxiv-2503-04737.creator: Jiayi Zhang*, Ryan S. Baker, Namrata Srivastava, Jaclyn Ocumpaugh, Caitlin Mills, Bruce M. McLaren
arxiv-2503-04737.description: Abstract Detection of carelessness in digital learning platforms has relied on the contextual slip model, which leverages conditional probability and Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) to identify careless errors, where students make mistakes despite having the knowledge. However, this model cannot effectively assess carelessness in questions tagged with multiple skills due to the use of conditional probability.

arxiv-2507-14501.title: Advances in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction and View Synthesis: A Survey
arxiv-2507-14501.creator: Jiahui Zhang, Yuelei Li, Anpei Chen, Muyu Xu, Kunhao Liu, Jianyuan Wang, Xiao-Xiao Long,Hanxue Liang, Zexiang Xu, Hao Su, Christian Theobalt, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi, Hanspeter Pfister, Shijian Lu, Fangneng Zhan
arxiv-2507-14501.description: Abstract 3D reconstruction and view synthesis are foundational problems in computer vision, graphics, and immersive technologies such as augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and digital twins. Traditional methods rely on computationally intensive iterative optimization in a complex chain, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2508-06589.title: A Federated Learning Framework for Handling Subtype Confounding and Heterogeneity in Large-Scale Neuroimaging Diagnosis
arxiv-2508-06589.description: Abstract Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems play a crucial role in analyzing neuroimaging data for neurological and psychiatric disorders. However, small-sample studies suffer from low reproducibility, while large-scale datasets introduce confounding heterogeneity due to multiple disease subtypes being labeled under a single category. To address these challenges, we propose a novel federated learning framework tailored for neuroimaging CAD systems.

pmc-10534216.title: An early asymptomatic diagnosis method for cork spot disorder in ‘Akizuki’ pear (Pyrus pyrifolia Nakai) using micro near infrared spectroscopy
pmc-10534216.creator: Li Liu, Hanhan Zhang, Lin Wu, Shangfeng Gu, Jing Xu, Bing Jia, Zhenfeng Ye, Wei Heng, Xiu Jin
pmc-10534216.description: Highlights•The rapid detection of asymptomatic fruit of ' Akizuki ' pear cork spot disorder was realized by near infrared spectroscopy.•Differences in mineral element content of samples were proved by physicochemical analysis.•Differences in NIR spectral profiles were corresponded to differences in mineral elements.•A classification model was established using supervised and unsupervised pattern recognition methods to identify asymptomatic fruits.

pmc-10782912.title: Identify gestational diabetes mellitus by deep learning model from cell-free DNA at the early gestation stage
pmc-10782912.creator: Yipeng Wang, Pei Sun, Zicheng Zhao, Yousheng Yan, Wentao Yue, Kai Yang, Ruixia Liu, Hui Huang, Yinan Wang, Yin Chen, Nan Li, Hailong Feng, Jing Li, Yifan Liu, Yujiao Chen, Bairong Shen, Lijian Zhao, Chenghong Yin
pmc-10782912.description: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is a common complication of pregnancy, which has significant adverse effects on both the mother and fetus. The incidence of GDM is increasing globally, and early diagnosis is critical for timely treatment and reducing the risk of poor pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-11468123.title: Integrated serum pharmacochemistry, 16S rDNA sequencing, and metabolomics to reveal the material basis and mechanism of Shouhui Tongbian capsule against diphenoxylate-induced slow transit constipation in rats
pmc-11468123.creator: Jiaying Yang, He Xiao, Jingchun Yao, Pin Zhang, Bojiao Yi, Zhengyu Fang, Na Guo, Yongxia Guan, Guimin Zhang
pmc-11468123.description: BackgroundSlow transit constipation (STC) is highly prevalent and has rising incidence. Shouhui Tongbian capsule (SHTB) is a traditional Chinese Medicine formula with extensive and highly efficacious usage in STC treatment, however, its mechanism of action, especially the regulation of microbiome and lipid metabolites, remains unclear.

pmc-11585929.title: A study on the knowledge, attitude, and practice of research integrity among medical professionals in Ningxia, China
pmc-11585929.creator: Yiran Jin, Jie Wei, Jingyi Zhang, Sang Luo, Liwei Yuan, Xiaojie Zou, Dan Liu
pmc-11585929.description: BackgroundThis study utilizes a Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice (KAP) questionnaire to investigate the awareness of medical professionals in the Ningxia region regarding research integrity and their attitudes towards academic misconduct. A comprehensive analysis of the factors contributing to academic misconduct is performed, with the aim of providing insights for the formulation of policies to enhance research integrity.

pmc-12452653.title: Predicting Sleep Quality Based on Metabolic, Body Composition, and Physical Fitness Variables in Aged People: Exploratory Analysis with a Conventional Machine Learning Model
pmc-12452653.creator: Pedro Forte, Samuel G Encarnação, José E Teixeira, Luís Branquinho, Tiago M Barbosa, António M Monteiro, Daniel Pecos-Martín, Michael O Harris-Love, Stefania Toselli, Luciana Zaccagni, Natascia Rinaldo
pmc-12452653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Sleep plays a crucial role in the health of older adults, and its quality is influenced by multiple physiological and functional factors. However, the relationship between sleep quality and physical fitness, body composition, and metabolic markers remains unclear. This exploratory study aimed to investigate the associations between sleep quality and physical, metabolic, and body composition variables in older adults, and to evaluate the preliminary performance of a logistic regression model in classifying sleep quality.

pmc-12843314.title: Catching the Storm Before It Breaks: Advancing Early Diagnosis and Intervention in Bipolar Disorder
pmc-12843314.creator: Marianna Mazza, Luca Chisari, Francesco Maria Lisci, Caterina Brisi, Giovanni Camardese, Domenico De Berardis, Luigi Janiri, Gabriele Sani, Giuseppe Marano
pmc-12843314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In recent years, growing attention has been directed toward the early diagnosis and intervention of bipolar disorder (BD), driven by the recognition that timely clinical action may significantly alter the trajectory of the illness. Early identification of individuals at risk, as well as intervention during prodromal or subthreshold phases, offers the potential to delay onset, reduce episode severity, improve long-term outcomes, and possibly prevent the full manifestation of the disorder.

pmc-13132279.title: Pilot Study: Hyaluronic Acid Fillers in the Management of Scars After Skin Cancer Surgery
pmc-13132279.creator: Harini Bala, Nisal Punchihewa, Philip Bekhor
pmc-13132279.description: Background:Scarring after skin cancer surgery, particularly facial surgery, poses significant aesthetic and psychological concerns for patients. Surgical revision, although effective, can be associated with increased morbidity and recovery time. Hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers offer a potential nonsurgical alternative for scar revision, but their use in post–skin cancer scar revision is not well documented.

pmc-13197652.title: Scalp and Neck Metastasis From HER2‐Positive Gastric Cancer: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13197652.creator: Ricardo Fernández-Ferreira, Jesus Montaño-Hernández, Rafael-Garza Cantú-Pedraza, Fernanda Delgado-Gutierrez, Renato-Adrian Flores-Vazquez, Mauricio-Lohengrin Durán-Aceves, Verónica Bautista-Piña, Rosa-María Vicuña-González, María-del-Carmen Burguete-Bojalil, Giovana-Ivette De-Lucio-Chavero
pmc-13197652.description: BackgroundCutaneous metastasis of gastric cancer is a rare manifestation (2.6%) of advanced gastrointestinal cancers and occurs in less than 1% of upper GI tract malignancies. The nodular type is the most common type. Tissue diagnosis and anatomic localization of the primary tumor are best obtained by upper gastrointestinal endoscopy.

pmc-13407849.title: In situ iodine generation enables solution-phase polymerization of organic pollutants for continuous resource recovery from water
pmc-13407849.creator: Yan Wei, Yuner Liu, Mingyang Li, Chaoyuan Deng, Bo He, Mingce Long, Yu-Xin Ye, Gangfeng Ouyang, Zhengjun Gong

pmc-13432139.title: A dimer peptide ligand of vascular endothelial growth factor slows the progression of human gastric tumors in mouse xenografts
pmc-13432139.creator: Xiaoqing Ye, Haofeng Hu, Yilei He, Fei Ye, Jia Jin, Elodie Olivier, Jean-François Gaucher, Lei Wang, Sylvain Broussy
pmc-13432139.description: Gastric cancer is among the most common cancers and represents a major public health problem worldwide. New therapeutic strategies and drugs are needed. Anti-angiogenic agents targeting the Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) are used in combination therapy in the clinic, although their efficacy remains modest.
